# Benchmark report

**No result set analysed yet.**

This file is generated by the `report` module (`--placeholder`). No benchmark result set has been
analysed, so it contains no numbers and no statement about the measured system. Once a result set has
been analysed, regenerating this file replaces this text with the report of that set.

## Limits

The following list is quoted verbatim from section 2 of the [benchmark protocol](benchmark-protocol.md).
It applies to every result set of that protocol, including this one.

<!-- quoted-limits:begin -->
- Anything about a real LLM, a real network, TLS, several hosts or production hardware: everything is synthetic and
  runs on `127.0.0.1` on one machine.
- Absolute capacity. The load generator, the gateway and the simulator share the CPU, memory and loopback stack of
  one machine. That is a bias of the set-up that no flag removes.
- Latency under a fixed arrival rate. The load model is closed (a fixed number of workers, each opening the next
  stream when the previous one ended), so coordinated omission is not corrected.
- Differences smaller than the run-to-run variation of the machine. The protocol records several repetitions per
  cell; whether they suffice is a question for the analysis step.
- Causes. The raw data can show that two modes differ; it cannot show why.
<!-- quoted-limits:end -->

## How to regenerate

The report is generated; do not edit it. The result set itself is never modified and is not committed.
To regenerate it from an archived result set, extract the archive into a new, empty directory outside
the repository (the extracted directory is the one that contains `manifest.json`), build the tool and run
it:

```bash
tar -xzf bench-<run-id>.tar.gz -C <new-empty-directory>
./mvnw -B package -DskipTests
java -jar report/target/report-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar --results <new-empty-directory>/<run-id> --check
java -jar report/target/report-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar --results <new-empty-directory>/<run-id> --out docs --overwrite
```

The same input gives byte-identical output. Without a result set,
`java -jar report/target/report-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar --placeholder --out docs --overwrite` writes the
placeholder version of this file. The data files are written to `docs/benchmark/`.
